name: Visa Inc.
summary: Visa Inc. functions globally as a leading technology company dedicated to payments, enabling the secure and efficient digital transfer of funds among consumers, businesses, banks, and governments. Its VisaNet transaction processing network handles authorization, clearing, and settlement of payment transactions worldwide. The company was established in 1958 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California. This row represents Visa Inc.'s Brazilian Depositary Receipt (BDR), traded on B3.
